facts.text: I am getting married soon.
I have been to a few weddings recently.
One wedding I attended was my cousin's wedding at a vineyard in August.
I am looking for wedding venue ideas.
I like the idea of an orchard wedding.
My cousin Rachel's wedding at the vineyard was perfect.
My cousin Rachel wore a lace gown at her wedding.
I want suggestions to incorporate rustic charm into the decor and theme for my wedding.
I am thinking of having a smaller, intimate ceremony.
I was a bridesmaid at my cousin Rachel's wedding.
I had not seen some family members in years and it was great to catch up with them at my cousin Rachel's wedding.
I am thinking of having a small, intimate ceremony with around 50 guests.
I want the reception to feel more like a dinner party rather than a big, formal wedding reception.
My cousin Emily's wedding in the city was lovely.
My cousin Emily's wedding had an intimate, romantic atmosphere in a rooftop garden and a trendy restaurant.
I would like to explore having a wine and cheese pairing station at the reception.
My cousin Rachel's wedding at the vineyard had a wine tasting.
I want suggestions on how to make the wine and cheese pairing station more personal and special.
I would like to explore having a custom wine blend created for my wedding.
I want a walkthrough of the process for creating a custom wine blend for my wedding.
